resources.string: Only when Bridgit\'s shared Jev and Clef allowance runs out. Then this phone\'s watches, Pet monitor and control agent questions keep working on your key, billed to your account. Your OpenRouter API key, from openrouter.ai/keys. Answers Jev and Clef questions with GLM 5.3 Flash when there\'s no TypeSafe or Cloudflare key (photos yes, audio and video no).
